_comment: One entry per home series. `owner_ids` are resolved start.gg owner ids, all of which get passed to `collect.py --owner-id` together (results are merged/deduped) since page-creation duty tends to rotate between a few organizers on the same series.

encore_smash.note: Encore's slug pattern has also changed over time (encore-smash-weekly-N in 2020-2021 vs encore-smash-N more recently) - collect.py's owner-based discovery handles this fine since it doesn't depend on slug format.

back_from_the_ded.note: Retired series. Only checked against cba (166752) so far, who does own at least some editions (e.g. Back From the DED Monthly #13). Worth re-checking against the other 3 undiscovered_smash owner ids too if a first pull looks incomplete.
